title: 국제환규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20080303:00003:part:1/1

ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Knowledge Economy and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Ordinance No. 1, March 3, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (6) Omitted.

(7) The Rules on International Money Orders shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 4, Article 5 (1), and the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 6, respectively, "Minister of Information and Communication" shall be replaced with "Minister of Knowledge Economy."

(8) through <64> Omitted.
